description: For one ANVISA rule (RDC or IN): its publication date and source, the ANVISA sanctions in the Diário Oficial that cite it as breached (date, act url, and the company only when the act names exactly one company by CNPJ), their count, the lag from publication to the first citing sanction when observable, and, counted apart, refusals of companies' own requests that cite the rule as grounds (these are NOT sanctions). Each act counts once. Use for 'who was sanctioned under RDC 47/2013 and since when'. Needs the pharmaceutical sector licensed. Deterministic: computed from official datasets, no model in the loop.

rule.description: The rule, e.g. 'RDC 47/2013', 'RDC nº 47, de 2013', 'rdc-anvisa-47:2013', 'IN 9/2014'. Without a year, every year on record for that number.

name: rule_enforcement
title: ANVISA sanctions citing one rule (Outcome Ledger)
